source.title: Four new tube-nosed bat species of the genus Murina (Chiroptera, Vespertilionidae) from Xizang Autonomous Region, China, based on morphological and molecular data

where: Research Article > Murina beibengensis Luo, Mao & Zhou, sp. nov. account, line under the heading 'Measurements (in mm) and body mass (in g) of the holotype.'
method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the description; Methods: measurements recorded to the nearest 0.1 mm using digital calipers
measurement: ear length of the holotype (EL: from lower edge of external auditory meatus to tip of pinna)
conditions: Holotype XZ2024037, body weight 6.20 g (BW: 6.20 in the cut part of the line). Sex is inconsistent within the paper: the Holotype paragraph prints 'Adult male, field number XZ2024037 (Figs 4, 5, Table 2)' but the Table 2 column header reads 'Holotype (Female)'; the measurement line itself states no sex and the value is the same either way. Table 2 row 'EL (ear length)' prints 16.18 for the holotype column. Values printed to 0.01 mm although Methods state calipers read to the nearest 0.1 mm. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
note: Quote is the first part of a longer measurement line (cut marked; the rest lists skull values and BW). Abbreviation expansions are from the Methods, not the quoted line (EL defined there as 'ear length (from lower edge of external auditory meatus to tip of pinna)'); the word 'holotype' is in the heading. Sibling M. medogensis EL is on main (desk-d345) and M. milinensis (desk-d347); beibengensis not on main (grepped species and DOI under any trait; an earlier note says it was withheld because of the sex conflict, which is disclosed here). Authority: Mammal Diversity Database taxon 1006943 Murina beibengensis (Luo et al. 2025, ZSE 101(3):1023-1055), species status field blank, 'recently described', opened. Licence sentence read on the article_preview page: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0)'. No Class/Order/Family headings printed; paper title/byline as printed in two pieces by the reader. Crossref not queried.

method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the description; Methods: measurements recorded to the nearest 0.1 mm using digital calipers
measurement: tragus length of the holotype (TRL: from base to tip of tragus)
conditions: Holotype XZ2024037, body weight 6.20 g (BW: 6.20 in the cut part of the line). Sex is inconsistent within the paper: the Holotype paragraph prints 'Adult male, field number XZ2024037 (Figs 4, 5, Table 2)' but the Table 2 column header reads 'Holotype (Female)'; the measurement line itself states no sex and the value is the same either way. Values printed to 0.01 mm although Methods state calipers read to the nearest 0.1 mm. Anatomy only; hearing not tested. Tragus length is the TRL entry (not width, TRW 2.29).
note: Same measurement line as the ear-length record, TRL entry; Methods define TRL as 'tragus length (from base to tip of tragus)'. Quote cut marked; word 'holotype' is in the heading. Authority and licence as in the ear-length record (MDD taxon 1006943 opened; CC BY 4.0 sentence read on the page). Not on main (species and DOI grepped).

measurement: ear length (E) of the single female entered for the species in Table 2 (columns FA 36.51 and GTL 16.83 match the holotype XZ2023107 as printed in the Holotype paragraph)
method: external measurement as printed in Table 2 (columns headed 'Species | Sex | FA | E | GTL | CBL | CCL | ZYW | IOW | BCW'); Methods: external and craniodental measurements taken with electronic digital calipers to the nearest 0.01 mm; abbreviation list prints 'E, ear length' with no landmark definition
conditions: Single female (Table 2 row sign '♀', no n) of Murina chayuensis sp. nov.; identified as the holotype XZ2023107 only by its FA and GTL values agreeing with the Holotype paragraph ('36.51 mm FA (forearm length) and 16.83 mm GTL (greatest length of skull)'); the text never states the holotype's sex. The species cell is merged over the two rows (male row n = 4, range 13.72–14.47, quoted for context; not filed). The Results text cites 'ear of M. huttonii is longer at 16.20–17.40 mm (vs. 13.72–14.82 mm; Table 2)'. The Methods say 'Eight adult bats were examined' although seven were collected (inconsistency within the paper). Table 2 caption 'External and cranial measurements (in mm) of Murina species' also holds comparison species. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

measurement: TD (horizontal tympanum diameter) 2.4 mm, holotype KU336975 (Male)
method: manual caliper measurement of preserved specimens; Methods: 'Morphological measurements were taken by MV with a manual caliper with a precision of 0.1 mm.'; item (4) of the Methods measurement list is horizontal tympanum diameter (TD)
conditions: Holotype KU336975, field number JJW2336, sex as printed in Table 1: Male; locality Ranomafana, Maharira. Table 1 (caption 'Morphometric measurements (in mm) of the two new species.') has six specimen columns: S. lavabato KU336975 (holotype, male), KU336977 (paratype, male), KU336978 (paratype, female), ZSM 806/2003 (paratype, male); S. lakolosy KU340852 (holotype, 'Female?'), KU340867 (paratype, female). TD values in column order 2.4, 1.7, 2.0, 2.1, 1.8, 2.2; this record is column 1. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
